verses.text: Yahweh said to Moses, ‘Look, I’m making you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will speak for you. 🗣️
‘You’ll tell Aaron everything I command you. He’ll speak to Pharaoh and tell him to let the Israelites leave his land. 📣
‘I’ll make Pharaoh stubborn, and I’ll do many signs and wonders in Egypt. ✨
‘Pharaoh won’t listen. So I’ll strike Egypt and bring my people Israel out—their families and tribes—through great acts of judgment. ⚖️
‘When I stretch out my hand over Egypt and bring Israel out, the Egyptians will know I am Yahweh.’ 🛡️
Moses and Aaron did exactly what Yahweh commanded them. ✅
Moses was eighty years old and Aaron was eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh. 🔢
Yahweh told Moses and Aaron: 📣
‘When Pharaoh says, “Show me a miracle,” tell Aaron, “Take your staff and throw it down in front of Pharaoh.” It’ll turn into a snake.’ 🐍
Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did what Yahweh commanded. Aaron threw down his staff in front of Pharaoh and his officials, and it turned into a snake. 🐍
Then Pharaoh called in his wise men and sorcerers. Egypt’s magicians did the same thing with their secret arts. 🎩
Each one threw down his staff, and they turned into snakes. But Aaron’s staff swallowed their staffs. 🐍
Still, Pharaoh became stubborn and wouldn’t listen, just as Yahweh had said. 😠
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Pharaoh’s heart is stubborn. He refuses to let the people go. ⚠️
‘Go meet Pharaoh in the morning when he heads to the river. Stand by the riverbank with the staff that turned into a snake in your hand. 🌅
‘Tell him: “Yahweh, God of the Hebrews, sent me to say, ‘Let my people go worship me in the wilderness.’ But until now you haven’t listened.” 📨
‘This is what Yahweh says: “Here’s how you’ll know I am Yahweh: I’ll strike the river water with the staff in my hand, and it’ll turn to blood. 🩸
“‘The fish in the river will die, the river will stink, and the Egyptians won’t be able to drink its water.”’ 🌊

‘Tell Aaron: “Take your staff and stretch out your hand over Egypt’s waters—rivers, canals, ponds, and every pool. They’ll all turn to blood. Blood will be everywhere in Egypt, even in wooden and stone containers.”’ 🩸
Moses and Aaron did what Yahweh commanded. Aaron raised the staff and struck the river in front of Pharaoh and his officials. All the river water turned to blood. 🩸
The fish died, the river stank, and the Egyptians couldn’t drink its water. Blood spread throughout Egypt. 💔
Egypt’s magicians used their secret arts to do the same. Pharaoh stayed stubborn and wouldn’t listen, just as Yahweh had said. ⚠️
Pharaoh turned around, went back to his palace, and didn’t even take it to heart. 🏛️
The Egyptians dug along the riverbank looking for water to drink, because they couldn’t drink from the river. ⛏️
Seven days passed after Yahweh struck the river. 🗓️
